scope: 115 C10 input/output contexts for typed P2 controls. No C10/C11/C13 modification, runtime logic, SQL/provider/Docker execution or generic JSON editor.
count_note: Exactly the 115 original contexts; modal/display/secret repetition is retained. Messenger reuses Facebook with an explicit integration channel; no synthetic extra context.

storage_policy.identity_scope: Every persisted value binds to exact institution and application/integration/endpoint IDs. Group/channel label is not an account identifier.
storage_policy.existing_columns: ExistingC11Application/Integration names reference real C11 columns. Writes remain subject to new P2 repository, revision, permissions and audit contracts.
storage_policy.channel_setting: Only explicit typed allowlisted keys. Configured intent never overwrites operational observations/evidence/quotas.
storage_policy.secret: Never plaintext in ChannelSetting. Server-resolved owner/kind/version. Omitted/blank preserves; revocation is explicit.
storage_policy.transient: PIN/current password never enter SQL, config, secret vault, audit, log or readback.
storage_policy.display: ExistingC11Projection or none/server_owned_projection is read-only; no fake persisted key for a display.
storage_policy.operational_gate: requires_provider_action identifies a P4 action-dependent input/result. Reading existing safe local metadata performs no provider call.

ambiguities.resolution: Derived outputs outside Application/Integration have storage none plus original C10 projection; no invented ChannelSetting equivalent. Multi-column local output uses read-only ExistingC11Projection.
Missing labels use source descriptive name or explicitly marked curated accessible label. Original per-channel labels remain in label_by_channel.
Source meta selector has no unique channel mapping; retain ChannelSelector/Provider distinction, never guess endpoint/integration.
Instagram Login uses instagram_user_access; Facebook Login uses instagram_page_access. Server resolves exact application issuer product, not channel alone.

Source descriptors mention verification hashing while C10 binding names SecretVersion ciphertext. Preserve reviewed C10 owner/kind here, never GET raw secret; final vault/hash lifecycle requires its own review.
Reuse Page/app/token controls with Channel=messenger and exact integration ID. Source 115 contexts have no standalone Messenger form; do not merge Facebook and Messenger accounts.
TikTokPolicy input maps to ChannelSetting source JSON keys, including runtime_policy.notes. This is not operational application to TikTokPolicy, evidence, quotas or send workers.
Source text controls need a separately reviewed typed-list conversion preserving separators/case. This data invents no parser.

Some source forms allow missing app_id/client_key, while the C11 Application.ClientId column is non-null/nonempty. P2 must retain an already selected application or require its valid ID; no dummy ClientId. Blank optional external IDs map to SQL NULL only if source conditional-required rules allow omission.

value_contract.null_bound_semantics: No confirmed source bound, not zero or unlimited acceptance by the final aggregate P2 document contract.
value_contract.arrays: UI text is split on comma/whitespace into arrays before the API. Saved arrays preserve case/order/duplicates; later P4 parsing is recorded separately.
value_contract.integers: Source clamps/coerces; P2 should validate strict typed JSON integers and reject out-of-range values.
value_contract.read_only: Disabled source provider/channel and all derived outputs keep their previous read-only/write prohibition and P4 gates.
value_contract.mapping: ChannelSetting keys are explicitly allowlisted literal flat keys. Existing-column mappings do not create a duplicate JSON setting.
